title: NHK World — 京都の旅 (Journey to Kyoto)
description: An NHK World Japan travel documentary exploring Kyoto — Japan's ancient capital for over a thousand years. Covers the golden pavilion Kinkakuji, geisha culture in Gion, traditional Kyoto cuisine, and the Gion Festival. Narrated in moderately paced Japanese suitable for N4 learners.
